ai_rules: Never invent an App ID. Only cite JAH-APP-###### IDs that resolve in the archive.
Never invent app features, capabilities, or compatibility claims. Use only the app's record.
If a record lacks a field, answer NOT SPECIFIED — never guess.
Distinguish: ARCHIVED APP (in data/index.json.gz) vs GENERATED EXPLANATION (your own words about it).
The browser experience is a working DEMO of the app class (demo_scope=DEMO), not a full production application.
Downloads (.txt/.json/.html/.py/.zip) are built deterministically from the app record.
Every app is an original Signature-line program by Justin Addam Higgins — inspired by its app class, copying no product, brand, or design.

archive.index: data/index.json.gz (JSONL rows: [id, family, seed, name, tagline])

determinism: The full app record is solved client-side from (family, seed, id) by code/appgen.js. Same inputs always yield the same record; VERIFY re-solves and compares.
id_format: JAH-APP-###### — zero-padded, permanent, never reused. Retired records become tombstones.
purpose: The Signature App Archive: original Signature-line versions of every phone and PC app category, marching to 1,000,000 apps.
search: Search the archive index (name, tagline, ID). Find searches the archive only — it never invents apps.

status_vocabulary.browser_demo: WORKING = a live interactive demo of the app's core function runs in the browser
status_vocabulary.demo_mode: LOCAL = the demo runs on the user's device, no network calls
status_vocabulary.demo_scope: DEMO = the browser experience is a working demo, not a full production application
status_vocabulary.python_companion: AVAILABLE = Python source download for the core function
